findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_filing_toc · Private data: get_latest_filing, list_filings, search_sec_event_filings · Public sink: get_latest_filing, list_filings · Destructive: search_sec_event_filings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_filing_toc · Private data: get_latest_filing, list_filings, search_sec_event_filings · Public sink: get_latest_filing, list_filings · Destructive: search_sec_event_filings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
